title: Instagram hashtags
lede: Hashtags are the # labels Instagram has supported since January 2011. Instagram says they tell it what a post is about but add no reach by themselves, and since December 2025 it allows five per post.

sections.heading: What the studies measured
sections.body: Later's 18.1 million feed posts had the highest average reach rate at 20 hashtags, with 30 close behind [1][2]. Fanpage Karma's 1.6 million posts did best at 5, with 2% more reach than posts with none, while 1 to 3 did slightly worse than none and more than 5 lost 3% [3][4][5]. Hootsuite's test on one account found that 10 posts with 3 to 5 hashtags averaged a reach of 462, against 394 for 10 posts with 30 [6][7]. Drag the count above to see what each study measured at that number, and where it measured nothing.

sections.heading: What Instagram says hashtags do
sections.body: Instagram says a hashtag tells it what a post is about and adds no reach by itself. Instagram chief Adam Mosseri [1] has said hashtags "don't work" to increase reach [2] but are "a great way to let people know what a post is about and connect posts" [3]. Feed ranks posts first on the viewer's own activity, then on signals such as how many people like a post and how quickly [4][5]. In search, Instagram scores a hashtag result partly by how closely the words typed match the words in the tag [6].

sections.heading: From 30 hashtags to five
sections.body: In 2021 a post could carry up to 30 hashtags, and Instagram's Creators account advised 3 to 5 [1][2][3]. In December 2025 Instagram began cutting the number a post or reel caption can carry to five [4][5], saying fewer, more targeted tags "can improve both your content's performance and people's experience on Instagram" [6]. Later's guide says the cap counts the caption and the comments together [7]. The timeline below marks what Instagram added and took away from 2011 to 2025.

sections.heading: What Instagram changed, 2011 to 2025
sections.body:
1. 2011January

    Hashtags arrive, to help people find photos and each other

  2. 2017December

    People can follow a hashtag in their feed

  3. 2020October 30

    "Recent" tab on hashtag pages removed for a while, over U.S. election misinformation

  4. 2021by November

    Up to 30 per post; Instagram's Creators account advises 3 to 5

  5. 2023April

    Searching recent hashtag posts removed for good

  6. 2024December 13

    Following hashtags ends

  7. 2025December

    Cap of five hashtags per post or reel caption

Added or allowedTaken away or limited
